**Analyzing Visual Layout**

I'm currently focused on improving the visual consistency of the `Collection` view. The existing layout utilizes a "distributed" approach with a margin-top on every fourth item. My initial goal is to find a more uniform alignment, eliminating the irregular spacing to create a cleaner presentation. I'm exploring how to modify the item margins for better visual harmony.


**Refining Spacing Patterns**

I'm now zeroing in on the dynamic margin and col-span logic within `Collection.tsx`. The aim is a more predictable, aligned layout. Removing the irregular offset created by the `mt-6` class seems the right path to achieve consistent visual alignment. I'm focusing on ensuring grid and item padding are uniform as well, and will attempt to standardize any "Bento" style elements to feel intentional, rather than haphazard.
